titles.en: Havoc Condition Manager - Solo Play Expansion

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay and also supports Realms sessions. Combine Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, choose a compatible environment, and adjust enemy spawn quantity or frequency from 1x to 5x. Havoc Enemy Director is optional.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，同时支持 Realms 联机会话。组合浩劫、金级／大漩涡及活动词条，选择兼容环境，并按敌人类别调整 1–5 倍刷新数量或速度。无需安装高级生成器即可使用。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，同時支援 Realms 聯機會話。組合浩劫、金級／大漩渦及活動詞條，選擇相容環境，並按敵人類別調整 1–5 倍刷新數量或速度。無需安裝高階生成器即可使用。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay and also supports Realms sessions. Combine Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, choose a compatible environment, and adjust enemy spawn quantity or frequency from 1x to 5x. Havoc Enemy Director is optional.
